places.name: Lorena's camp
places.note: Lorena sends Newt away; he secretly watches from a live-oak grove nearby, dozes, and loses his horse Mouse during a night stampede.
places.location_hint: a couple of miles due east of the Hat Creek herd's camp, under trees with a live-oak stand about a hundred yards off

places.name: Hat Creek outfit's cow camp
places.note: The herd stampedes at night toward the bluffs; at dawn Pea finds Newt afoot and the new cook Po Campo walks in with his donkey.
places.location_hint: open grassy country with ridges and bluffs; Lorena's camp lies a couple of miles to the east

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Newt recalls Sean O'Brien's muddy grave back by this river.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Newt longs for the biscuits Augustus baked there before leaving his ovens behind.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Montana
places.note: Newt fears the cowboys would joke about him all the way there.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: herd regathered after a night stampede

groups.label: Newt and Po Campo
groups.hint: walking the last few hundred yards to the wagon
